001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.tutorial;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MonthlyReport;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MonthlyReport.FDNode;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners.EconomyTickListener;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.shared.SharedData;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
011
012public class SpacerObligation implements EconomyTickListener, TooltipCreator {
013
014        public static int DEBT_BASE = 1000;
015        public static int DEBT_PER_LEVEL = 3000;
016        
017        protected long startTime = 0;
018        public SpacerObligation() {
019                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
020                startTime = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
021        }
022        
023        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
024                if (Misc.isSpacerShareEnabled()) return;
025                
026                int lastIterInMonth = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth") - 1;
027                if (iterIndex != lastIterInMonth) return;
028                
029                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
030
031
032                int debt = getDebt();
033                FDNode fleetNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.FLEET);
034                
035                FDNode stipendNode = report.getNode(fleetNode, "SpacerObligation");
036                stipendNode.upkeep = debt;
037                stipendNode.name = "An obligation from your past";
038                stipendNode.icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("income_report", "generic_expense");
039                stipendNode.tooltipCreator = this;
040        }
041        
042        protected int getDebt() {
043                int extraPerLevel = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_extraSpacerDebtPerLevel") : 0; 
044                return DEBT_BASE + (Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().getLevel() - 1) * (DEBT_PER_LEVEL + extraPerLevel);
045        }
046
047        public void reportEconomyMonthEnd() {
048        }
049
050        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
051                tooltip.addPara("You never talk about it.", 
052                                0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), Misc.getDGSCredits(getDebt()));
053        }
054
055        public float getTooltipWidth(Object tooltipParam) {
056                return 450;
057        }
058
059        public boolean isTooltipExpandable(Object tooltipParam) {
060                return false;
061        }
062}
